description: Meeting document upload gate: access, file count, sizes, type agreement and hostile content.
precondition: Active user who may read the meeting; candidate files with names and bytes.

preconditions: One candidate: a 2 MB file "Bao-cao-Q3.pdf" whose bytes are a valid 12-page PDF; page counter returns 12.
cases.return: Outcome with no failure and one file: name "Bao-cao-Q3.pdf", content type application/pdf, 2,097,152 bytes, 12 pages, lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes.

preconditions: One candidate: "Nghi-quyet.docx" whose bytes are a valid DOCX package.
cases.return: No failure; one file with the DOCX content type, no page count (null), SHA-256 set; the page counter is not called.

preconditions: No file selected.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (HTTP 400, MSG164); errors["files"] = ["Chưa chọn tệp nào."].

preconditions: Ten valid small PDFs submitted together.
cases.return: No failure; 10 files returned in submission order.

preconditions: Eleven candidates submitted together.
cases.return: Failure TooMany (HTTP 400, MSG288); no file is inspected.

preconditions: Four valid files whose lengths add to exactly 200 MB.
cases.inputs: candidates: 4 files of 50 MB (52,428,800 bytes) each.
cases.return: No failure; the total limit is inclusive and each file is within 50 MB.

preconditions: Five files whose lengths add to more than 200 MB.
cases.inputs: candidates: 5 files of 50 MB each (250 MB).
cases.return: Failure TooMany (HTTP 400, MSG288).

preconditions: One candidate whose name is only invisible characters / blank after trimming.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["Tệp thứ 1: tên tệp không hợp lệ."].

preconditions: One candidate whose name contains a right-to-left override character.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["Tệp thứ 1: tên tệp không hợp lệ."]; the label uses the position because the name is unusable.

preconditions: One candidate with zero bytes.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["rong.pdf: tệp rỗng."].

preconditions: One candidate of exactly 50 MB with a valid PDF body.
cases.return: No failure; the file size limit is inclusive.

preconditions: One candidate of 50 MB plus 1 byte.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["lon.pdf: tệp lớn hơn 50 MB."]; the bytes are not read.

preconditions: One candidate of 1 byte with a valid name.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["a.pdf: không phải tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ."], because 1 byte is not a PDF.

preconditions: One candidate with an extension that is neither .pdf nor .docx.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["bang-tinh.xlsx: chỉ nhận tệp .pdf hoặc .docx."].

preconditions: One candidate called "page.pdf" whose bytes are an HTML page.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["page.pdf: không phải tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ."].

preconditions: One candidate called "x.docx" whose bytes are a PDF.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["x.docx: không phải tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ."] because the extension disagrees with the bytes.

preconditions: One candidate called "macro.docx" whose bytes are a macro-enabled DOCM package.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["macro.docx: không phải tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ."].

preconditions: One PDF candidate whose structure cannot be read; page counter returns null.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors["files[0]"] = ["hong.pdf: không phải tệp PDF hoặc DOCX hợp lệ."].

preconditions: Three candidates: a valid PDF, an empty file, and an .exe.
cases.return: Failure Invalid (MSG164); errors has files[1] = ["rong.docx: tệp rỗng."] and files[2] = ["tool.exe: chỉ nhận tệp .pdf hoặc .docx."]; every bad file is reported and no file list is returned.

preconditions: Candidate name with a Windows path: "C:\Docs\bao-cao.pdf" with valid PDF bytes.
cases.return: No failure; the stored file name is "bao-cao.pdf".

preconditions: A valid candidate whose stream is read twice (type detection, then hash).
cases.return: The SHA-256 is computed over the whole file from position 0 and the returned file can reopen its stream for storing.
